Name: ZoomFix for Stardew Valley Android
Author: justcallmeR7
Description:
ZoomFix – Fix Vanilla Zoom Reset Bug

Fixes the well‑known vanilla bug in Stardew Valley Android/Mobile, where the game keeps forcing zoom back to default after events or cutscenes. This mod automatically saves your preferred zoom level and restores it instantly, right when the game loads, or whenever that unwanted reset happens.

Features
- Console command available:  set_zoom <value>  — adjust zoom level anytime. Example:  set_zoom 1.0  = 100%
- Remembers & loads your preferred zoom automatically
- Works fully with the game’s built‑in pinch‑zoom system
- Can edit config file directly to set & save your preferred zoom level

Requirements
- Stardew Valley Android/Mobile Version
- SMAPI
